description: This file defines the SubjectNotModifiableException class, which is a custom runtime exception indicating that a subject could not be modified due to insufficient permissions. It includes builder patterns, methods for creating instances from messages or JSON, and is associated with policy-related exception handling in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: SubjectNotModifiableException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating a failure to modify a subject due to permission issues, including builder methods and serialization from JSON.

classes.name: SubjectNotModifiableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of SubjectNotModifiableException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for SubjectNotModifiableException with specified policy ID, label, and path.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
